name: Proxmox VE
author: Netlens
description: Reads your Proxmox VMs and containers so the map and device pages show which devices run on which Proxmox host. Read-only.

config.label: Proxmox URL
config.help: The address of the web interface. HTTPS port 8006 is assumed when you leave the port out.

config.label: Verify TLS certificate
config.help: Turn off for the self-signed certificate Proxmox uses by default.

config.label: Token ID
config.section: API token (recommended; give it the read-only PVEAuditor role)

config.label: Token secret
config.section: API token (recommended; give it the read-only PVEAuditor role)
config.help: The token is used when both token fields are filled.
